theme:ai-power.value: 2026-10-16 Venture Global signed frame agreements with GE Vernova and Baker Hughes for up to 16 gas fired power island units of 720 MW each, plus transformers, to support up to 10 GW of data center compute by 2034. If every order goes ahead the bill is about $17.2 billion (8-K); the first order is planned by the end of 2026 and first power in late 2028 or early 2029. Off grid gas keeps winning because the grid queue is too slow.
theme:ai-power.was: 2026-10-13 The Energy Department offered Vistra a conditional loan of up to $4.2 billion (announced Oct 5) for uprates and upgrades at Beaver Valley, Davis-Besse and Perry. The work adds 433 MW, keeps nearly 4 GW of nuclear online for 20 more years and backs a 2.6 GW power deal with Meta. Cheap federal money for uprates lowers the cost of new nuclear output for data centers.

theme:robotics-automation.value: 2026-10-13 XPeng set a timeline for its IRON humanoid at its Oct 12 Paris event: mass production by the end of 2026, deliveries in the first half of 2027, starting in stores and malls, and Europe later in 2027. Separately, a Wall Street Journal report says Walmart is still struggling to automate its US warehouses and that Symbotic does not expect a workable in store model until 2028.
theme:robotics-automation.was: 2026-10-12 Two green lights for autonomy. Waymo closed a $5 billion term loan, its first debt, led by Pimco, Blackstone and Sixth Street. And the FMCSA granted a five year exemption (Oct 7, 2026 to Oct 7, 2031) that lets driverless trucks use cab mounted beacons instead of warning triangles, removing the last routine task that needed a person on board.

theme:critical-materials.value: 2026-10-16 Alcoa reported Q3 on Oct 15: adjusted EPS $1.82, revenue $3.7 billion (down from $3.97 billion in Q2 on lower metal prices), free cash flow $472 million, alumina output up 11% to 2.5 million tons, and the Alumar smelter in Brazil fully restarted. South32 holders approved the AliGroup deal, which Alcoa expects to close in the first half of 2027.
theme:critical-materials.was: 2026-10-11 The rare earth deadline moved. The US China truce, which keeps China's October 2025 rare earth rules suspended, now runs to January 10, 2027 instead of November 10, 2026, per Bessent (Sep 23) and China's commerce ministry (Sep 28). Western producers get two more months without a supply shock, but the ministry statement does not name rare earths, so watch for a formal notice.

theme:defense-reshoring.value: 2026-10-10 Raytheon won a multiyear SM-3 Block IB interceptor contract worth up to $6.3 billion, about $4.4 billion of it in the base years, with work through 2034. Missile defense money keeps moving into multiyear deals, which gives RTX and its suppliers years of visibility.

theme:space-quantum-cyber.value: 2026-10-12 IonQ agreed to buy zero trust network security firm Elisity for up to $1.3 billion in stock (reported Oct 12 by Investor's Business Daily and by CNBC citing the Wall Street Journal). It is IonQ's latest all stock deal after Oxford Ionics and SkyWater, pushing it further into security; the shares fell more than 2% premarket.
theme:space-quantum-cyber.was: 2026-10-10 The FCC approved SpaceX's plan for 15,000 direct to phone satellites (order dated Oct 6), though use of the EchoStar bands waits on a close expected by Nov 30, 2027. DARPA moved IonQ and IBM into the final stage of its quantum benchmarking program on Oct 7; IonQ's deal is worth up to $300 million through 2029.

theme:healthcare-medtech.value: 2026-10-16 Health care led the S&P 500 again on Oct 15, up 1.8% and 4.3% over two sessions (TheStreet), and the big health care ETF hit an intraday record. By dashboard closes LLY rose 3.5% to 1,251.61 on 1.55x volume, MDT 1.3% to 95.45 on 2.8x volume and PFE 0.8% to 29.44. All three are now above their buy zones, so their verdicts moved from 'Buy zone now' to 'Accumulate on pullback'. No trial result or approval drove it; it is money leaving tech.
theme:healthcare-medtech.was: 2026-10-15 Health care was the best S&P 500 sector on Oct 14, up 2.44% while the index fell 1.11%, as money left tech after the hot CPI. UnitedHealth rose about 4.6% to 4.8%, a day after giving back its post earnings gap, and big drug makers rose about 3% to 4% midday (Merck 4.09%, AbbVie 3.94%, Lilly 3.38%). Abbott reports Q3 on Oct 21.

theme:ai-compute.value: 2026-10-16 The AI selloff paused on Oct 15. The Nasdaq closed up 0.1% at 26,713.02 after falling more than 1% early. By dashboard closes CoreWeave rose 5.9% to 69.69 after Nvidia's Jensen Huang said it needs no Nvidia backstop, Oracle rose 3.0% to 134.47 and Micron 1.9% to 931.24, while Nvidia fell 1.8% to 217.23 and the TSMC ADR 1.8% to 422.25. In Europe ASM International fell about 7% and Infineon about 5%. HPE fell about 7% on Oct 14 after Barclays cut it to Equal Weight, citing weak AI driven growth.
theme:ai-compute.was: 2026-10-15 TSMC's Q3 revenue was $46.72 billion (up 41.2%) with a 66.4% gross margin inside its 65% to 67% guide; it guided Q4 to $52.3 to $54.3 billion, raised 2026 growth to about 44% and kept 2026 capex at $60 to $64 billion, saying AI demand is far above supply. The stocks fell anyway as the selloff turned to debt: CoreWeave dropped about 15% on Oct 14 with its bonds near 15% yields, Oracle's five year CDS hit a record 288 basis points, Micron closed down 4.1% at $914.13, and on Oct 15 SK hynix fell about 11%, Samsung about 9.5% and Advantest about 15%.

theme:fintech-crypto-rails.value: 2026-10-16 Interactive Brokers reported Q3 on Oct 15: accounts up 35% to 5.58 million, customer equity up 27% to $964.7 billion, margin loans up 36% to $105.2 billion, and the quarterly dividend raised to $0.15 from $0.0875. Separately the SEC approved Cboe binary options tied to company metrics (Chair Atkins, Oct 13), covering more than 100 metrics at 23 companies; Robinhood is expected to offer them first, with no launch date set.
theme:fintech-crypto-rails.was: 2026-10-15 Schwab earned $1.69 a share adjusted (vs $1.66 expected) on about $7.17 billion of revenue, slightly light, with core net new assets up 38% to $190.4 billion and margin loans up 14% in the quarter to $187.9 billion (Oct 15). Bank of America closed Oct 14 down 4.76% at $51.39 after its miss and penalty.

industry:communications.value: 2026-10-16 Rechecked on the daily rotation. Ericsson's Q3 (Oct 15) showed sales of SEK 59.5 billion against 56.2 billion a year ago, 7% organic growth led by Networks, and net income down to about SEK 5.8 billion because last year included a divestment gain. It still sees a flat radio market in 2026 and rising AI driven component costs. The ERIC ADR jumped 11.8% to 10.71 on about 4.5 times normal volume. Amazon had almost 400 Leo satellites up as of Oct 9; AST has not yet dated its next launch.

industry:financials.value: 2026-10-13 Morgan Stanley moved its target for tokenized stock trading on its alternative trading system to Q1 2027 from the second half of 2026 (said Oct 12 at TOKEN2049), citing market plumbing, products and rules that still need time. It still sees tokenized real world assets reaching $3 to $10 trillion by 2030, against about $39 to $40 billion today.
industry:financials.was: 2026-10-12 Treasury issued its first GENIUS Act rule (an interim final rule reported Sep 30): stablecoin issuers above $10 billion must move to the federal framework within 360 days unless waived, which shuts the state route for Tether and Circle. The OCC says its own final rule is targeted for November.

industry:healthcare.value: 2026-10-11 FDA accepted Intellia's lonvo-z filing with priority review and set a March 10, 2027 decision date, with no advisory panel planned. The first in vivo CRISPR approval now has a date, and chronic HAE drug makers have a clock on them.

industry:industrials.value: 2026-10-13 Symbotic announced on Oct 13 that it is buying cellumation, a Bremen sortation company whose software driven floor replaces fixed conveyors. At the same time a Wall Street Journal report says Walmart's warehouse automation keeps hitting breakdowns and that Symbotic does not expect a workable in store pickup model until 2028, which pushes out the 400 store option.

industry:materials.value: 2026-10-14 Rechecked on the daily rotation. Hexcel confirmed it will report Q3 results on Oct 21 after the close, with the call Oct 22; third party calendars showing Oct 26 or Oct 28 are wrong. MP Materials still guides first commercial magnet shipments to GM for Q4 2026, with no shipment date announced.

industry:space.value: 2026-10-15 Rechecked on the daily rotation. Starship Flight 14 (Sep 28) was the first to reach orbit and deployed all 26 Starlink V3 satellites, though a vacuum engine failed and the stay in orbit was cut short; Flight 15 is penciled for no earlier than Oct 19 but not confirmed. SpaceX was reported Oct 6 to 7 to be seeking about $40 billion of debt to buy Nvidia chips. Planet Labs stock is down about 66% from its May peak even with record revenue, as money rotates to SpaceX and rates rise.

industry:technology.value: 2026-10-12 IonQ agreed to buy Elisity, a zero trust network security company, for up to $1.3 billion in stock (reported Oct 12). It is a revenue and product grab, not a quantum milestone, and it adds dilution.

industry:transportation.value: 2026-10-12 Waymo closed a $5 billion term loan, upsized from about $3 billion and priced at 5.25 points over the benchmark rate, to expand its fleet in the US and abroad. Lenders funding robotaxis is a sign the business is moving from research to fleet operations.

country:argentina.value: 2026-10-14 INDEC said September prices rose 1.9% in the month, in line with the 1.9% forecast and up from 1.7% in August. Yearly inflation is 33.4% and prices are up 23.6% in 2026. Housing, water, power and fuel rose most, 3.1%, as subsidies keep falling.
country:argentina.was: 2026-09-29 An IMF mission to Buenos Aires ended Sep 29 without closing the third program review. Reserves near $48.7 billion and a peso well inside its band support the case, but the review is still pending.

country:brazil.value: 2026-10-16 The runoff is tightening. Quaest (Oct 10 to 13, 2,154 people, released Oct 14) has Flavio Bolsonaro at 51% of valid votes to Lula's 49%, and O Povo reports Datafolha (Oct 13 to 15) at the same 51% to 49%, down from 52% to 48% earlier and inside the 2 point margin of error. EWZ fell 2.4% to 41.58 on Oct 15.
country:brazil.was: 2026-10-13 AtlasIntel's runoff poll for Bloomberg (Oct 3 to 8, 5,026 people, released Oct 9) gives Flavio Bolsonaro 52.8% of valid votes to Lula's 47.2%, wider than Datafolha's 52% to 48%. Bolsonaro rose from 47.4% to 51.1% of total votes since Atlas's last poll, breaking the earlier tie.

country:china.value: 2026-10-16 China's September exports rose 36.3% from a year ago (25% in August) and imports about 31%, for a $133.5 billion monthly surplus; chip exports rose 108.1% and exports to the US 39.6% (released Oct 14). The nine month surplus is about $938 billion, which adds to EU and US pressure to rebalance trade.
country:china.was: 2026-10-12 China's CXMT said its fifth generation DRAM platform (G5) is in mass production, and it held about 10% of world DRAM in Q2 2026. Memory stocks fell on Oct 12: Micron about 2% premarket, Samsung and SK Hynix more than 4% in Seoul. Separately, the Oct 9 EU-China understanding would roughly halve Chinese hybrid car exports to Europe over four years.

country:europe.value: 2026-10-16 Ericsson beat on Q3 sales (SEK 59.5 billion, 7% organic growth) and its ADR jumped 11.8% on Oct 15, while European chip stocks fell again: ASM International about 7% and Infineon about 5% (CNBC). AI hardware is under pressure in Europe too, but telecom networks are recovering.
country:europe.was: 2026-10-15 Zelenskyy told the Financial Times that Ukraine will resume strikes on Russian refineries because Russia kept hitting Ukraine's grid during the three day energy truce; on Oct 15 Russia said a drone set the Ryazan refinery on fire. The US is separately weighing easing shadow fleet tanker sanctions to cut freight costs.

country:gulf.value: 2026-10-15 A Houthi spokesman said Oct 14 that attacks on Saudi oil facilities and airports will continue 'in the coming days' (House of Saud citing Reuters and gCaptain; less established source). Reuters reported the US is weighing letting sanctioned tankers carry non sanctioned oil out of the Gulf to cut record freight rates; analysts expect only a few extra ships. Brent fell about 1.5% to about $104.44 on Oct 15.
country:gulf.was: 2026-10-14 A Houthi ballistic missile hit an Aramco administrative building at its Dhahran headquarters early Oct 14, causing a limited fire and damaging the top floors used by executives; reports differ on injuries (none per AP, four per Riyadh via IBTimes). On Oct 13 UKMTO reported a tanker struck in the Strait of Hormuz, which Iran said hit a mine, and two container ships hit by projectiles. Brent rose 0.58% to $106.30 and WTI 1.57% to $95.62 by 8:03am ET.

country:india.value: 2026-10-16 India's September consumer prices rose 5.54% from a year ago, up from 4.83% in August, with food up 7.74% (MoSPI, Oct 12). Inflation is now above the RBI's own 5.2% forecast, which backs its Oct 7 hike and keeps another one possible.
country:india.was: 2026-10-13 India's 10 year bond yield rose to 7.37% on Oct 12, its highest since October 2023, even as the rupee bounced about 1% to near 95.76 per dollar on the RBI's new curbs. Bloomberg called the curbs among the strongest currency defenses since the 2013 taper tantrum.

country:japan.value: 2026-10-16 The Nikkei rose about 1.4% to 65,324.29 on Oct 16 (AP; Saxo later had +1.8% to 65,584.61) after its 4.9% drop, as Wall Street steadied and Fed Chair Warsh called AI a big plus for growth.
country:japan.was: 2026-10-15 The Nikkei fell 4.9% to 64,425.95 on Oct 15, its third biggest point drop ever, as the AI selloff spread from Korea and the US. Advantest fell about 15% and SoftBank Group 8% to 10%; Tokyo Electron fell about 5% to 8%. The yen firmed to just under 158 per dollar.

country:mexico.value: 2026-10-13 The peso rebounded 0.73% to about 18.26 per dollar on Oct 12 after last week's slide to its weakest since November 2025. September inflation rose to 3.45% a year from 3.26%, a bit under the 3.47% forecast. Banxico's next decision is Nov 5 at 6.50%.
country:mexico.was: 2026-10-09 The peso slid to about 18.41 per dollar, its weakest since November 2025, as the carry trade unwound. That hurts dollar earnings of Mexican companies and helps exporters and tourism.

country:south-korea.value: 2026-10-16 The KOSPI bounced on Oct 16 after the 7.57% crash: AP had it up about 2.1% at 5,668.05 early, and Saxo later reported a 4.11% gain to 5,782.62, with Samsung and SK hynix steadying. The close was not confirmed at writing.
country:south-korea.was: 2026-10-15 The KOSPI plunged 7.57% to 5,554.22 on Oct 15 ('Black Thursday'), its seventh straight loss, with a sell side sidecar at 9:07am and a Level 1 circuit breaker at 12:38pm. SK hynix fell about 11% to 1,262,000 won and Samsung about 9.5% to 210,000 won. Analysts cited AI return doubts, China's CXMT and US rate hike risk.

country:taiwan.value: 2026-10-15 TSMC beat and raised (Q3 revenue $46.72 billion, gross margin 66.4%, 2026 growth now about 44%, capex unchanged at $60 to $64 billion), yet its shares fell about 2% and the Taiex had its sixth steepest point drop with a record NT$302.56 billion of net foreign selling on Oct 15.
country:taiwan.was: 2026-10-13 The Taiex fell 1.95% to 48,341 on Oct 13 as foreign investors sold a net NT$165 billion, the third largest foreign sale on record, after the US chip selloff and Korea's crash. TSMC fell 1.97% to NT$2,490 two days before its results.
